title: Colocation Data Center, 2 Data Halls (12 MW)
scope: Two 6 MW data halls, central electrical building, generator yard and roof chillers. Baseline with long-lead equipment and commissioning L1-L5.
assume: Halls 40 m × 30 m, 8.5 m to top of steel; 10 m × 10 m column grid; roof chillers on dunnage.
Chilled water: supply and return mains per rack row at 7.3 m, hangers at 3 m, isolation valves at row ends.
Commissioning L3 to L5 shown as status changes: cyan = under test, green = accepted.
